name: FXVersioned
cause: Two C declarations with no definition disagree; the rule merges them (ruling of 2026-10-10): the earliest introduction, the latest deprecation only when every available declaration deprecates, unavailable only when every declaration is. The second declaration names no availability in the IR (clang drops an attribute that does not match the first), so it carries no fact and the annotated declaration decides.

name: old
cause: The class declares iOS 14.0 and the extension redeclares it for iOS 16.0, later: the stricter, later availability counts (ruling D3).

name: tweak
cause: The extension states iOS 12.0, earlier than the class defining declaration (14.0): the defining declaration counts (ruling D3).
